# AlignAsya - Physiotherapy and Wellness Center

A modern physiotherapy and wellness sanctuary at Mira Road, Mumbai, Thane, led by Dr. Renu Saroj — pairing evidence-based rehabilitation with a personal, calming approach to recovery. AlignAsya offers eight clinical specialties, four hands-on treatment modalities, and an educational wellness blog across a multi-page website.

---

## 1. Hero / Introduction
Welcome to AlignAsya — a modern physiotherapy and wellness centre led by Dr. Renu Saroj. Personalized rehabilitation, pain management, sports therapy, and holistic wellness programs. At AlignAsya Physiotherapy Centre, Mira Road, Mumbai, we provide comprehensive, evidence-based physiotherapy care using modern treatment modalities. Our physiotherapists focus on relieving pain, restoring movement, and enhancing overall quality of life through personalized treatment plans, combining manual therapy, therapeutic exercises, electrotherapy, and hands-on modalities for faster recovery and long-term results across all age groups.

---

## 2. About Us
Dr. Renu Saroj is a dedicated physiotherapist with extensive experience in musculoskeletal and sports rehabilitation. Her approach is patient-centred, evidence-based, and focused on returning patients safely to the activities they love. She and her team are trained in a range of therapeutic techniques to restore movement, alleviate pain, and enhance overall mobility, treating musculoskeletal conditions across all ages — from children to older adults. As an ANC-PNC certified coach and Women's Health specialist, Dr. Renu also offers structured programs designed around the unique needs of pregnancy, postpartum, and beyond.

---

## 3. Clinical Specialties
Full detail pages: https://alignasya.com/index.html#services

- **Sports Injury Management** (https://alignasya.com/sports-injury-management.html): Fast-tracked kinetic analysis, athletic conditioning, dynamic muscle retraining, and joint stabilization. Treats ACL & ligament injuries, muscle strains/tears, tendon injuries, ankle sprains, shoulder instability, and stress fractures.
- **Orthopedic Spine & Joint** (https://alignasya.com/orthopedic-spine-joint.html): Structural solutions for chronic sciatica, lumbar strains/disc issues, cervical spondylosis, knee osteoarthritis, frozen shoulder, and spinal stenosis.
- **Neurological Rehabilitation** (https://alignasya.com/neurological-rehabilitation.html): Neuroplasticity-based programs for post-stroke recovery, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, spinal cord injuries, peripheral neuropathies, and balance/fall-risk training.
- **Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy** (https://alignasya.com/musculoskeletal-physiotherapy.html): Diagnosis and treatment of muscle, joint, and spine-related conditions — back/neck pain, shoulder/knee/joint disorders, arthritis, post-fracture and post-surgical rehabilitation.
- **Women's Health & Antenatal Care** (https://alignasya.com/womens-health-antenatal-care.html): Antenatal exercise programs, pregnancy back/pelvic pain management, postnatal rehabilitation, pelvic floor strengthening, and diastasis recti/core recovery.
- **Geriatric Physiotherapy** (https://alignasya.com/geriatric-physiotherapy.html): Balance and fall-prevention training, joint stiffness and pain management, osteoporosis/arthritis care, strength and mobility enhancement, and home care physiotherapy.
- **Pediatric Physiotherapy** (https://alignasya.com/pediatric-physiotherapy.html): Care for developmental delays, cerebral palsy, postural and gait abnormalities, congenital/neurological conditions, and early motor concerns like torticollis.
- **Wellness & Preventive Care** (https://alignasya.com/wellness-preventive-care.html): Posture assessment and correction, ergonomic advice, movement screening, flexibility/core stability training, and injury-prevention programs.

---

## 4. Treatment Modalities
- **Dry Needling** (https://alignasya.com/dry-needling.html): Thin, sterile needles target trigger points and tight muscle bands to release tension. Used for myofascial trigger points, chronic neck/shoulder pain, tension headaches, and sports-related muscle tightness.
- **Kinesio Taping** (https://alignasya.com/kinesio-taping.html): Elastic therapeutic tape supports muscles and joints while allowing full range of motion. Used for joint support, swelling reduction, postural correction, and sports support.
- **Cupping Therapy** (https://alignasya.com/cupping.html): Suction cups create negative pressure to promote blood flow and ease muscle tightness. Used for chronic back/neck pain, sports recovery, and restricted tissue mobility.
- **Manual Therapy** (https://alignasya.com/manual-therapy.html): Hands-on joint mobilization, soft tissue work, and myofascial release. Used for joint stiffness, frozen shoulder, back/neck pain, and post-surgical stiffness.

- **Why Your Back Hurts — and What You Can Do About It** (https://alignasya.com/blog-back-pain.html): Understanding common causes of back pain and physiotherapist-backed steps toward recovery and confident movement.

- **Understanding Cervical Spondylosis** (https://alignasya.com/blog-cervical-spondylosis.html): Neck pain causes, ergonomic principles, targeted exercises, and physiotherapy for cervical spondylosis.
- **Physiotherapy Treatment for Sciatica** (https://alignasya.com/blog-sciatica.html): What causes sciatic nerve pain and how physiotherapy — nerve mobilization, core stability and targeted exercise — can bring lasting relief.
- **Pediatric Physiotherapy for Children** (https://alignasya.com/blog-pediatric-physiotherapy.html): Signs, benefits and what to expect from child physiotherapy — from torticollis and developmental delays to cerebral palsy and gait concerns.

## 6. Key Benefits / Value Proposition
- Led by Dr. Renu Saroj, an ANC-PNC certified coach and Women's Health specialist.
- Evidence-based, personalized treatment plans across all age groups — pediatric through geriatric.
- Combines clinical specialties with hands-on modalities (dry needling, kinesio taping, cupping, manual therapy) for a complete recovery plan.
- Home visit / domiciliary physiotherapy available for patients managing conditions like post-operative recovery, stroke rehabilitation, or paralysis who cannot travel to the clinic.

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions
- **Referrals:** No doctor's referral is required to book an appointment at AlignAsya.
- **Home visit charges:** Typically range between ₹800–₹2,500 per session depending on condition severity and equipment needed; contact the clinic for an exact quote.
- **Physiotherapy vs. chiropractic care:** AlignAsya combines gentle joint mobilization with muscle retraining, posture correction, and electrotherapy, rather than manipulation alone.
- **Non-surgical options:** Orthopedic physiotherapy techniques (mechanical decompression, core strengthening, tissue-regeneration modalities) are used to help patients with knee osteoarthritis or lumbar disc issues avoid or delay surgery where appropriate.
